d: At the site of the former Yugoslavian Consulate, Ted hopes to salvage invaluable secret relics of the Cold War; back at the National, a buyer shows interest in a vintage WW2 truck, but Ted must convince him the price is right.

A deathly bin sends buyers spinning and throws everybody on edge. Then, Brandon and Lori square off against Scott and Chrissy with explosive attacks and counter-attacks. Emotion, rather than strategy, threatens to rule the day.

Sean holds a one of a kind auction at the Rolls Royce of storage facilities. Jesse draws on his pinball skills to outwit his competitors, while Brandon and Lori take one of the biggest gambles of their career.
Things get hairy for the hunters as some ring in the money while others go for broke. Desert Dan returns to turn up the heat as T Money continues to march to the beat of his own drum.
The potential for big money brings out fierce competition at this rare high stakes RV auction, and Brandon and Lori are determined to keep Scott and Chrissy from walking away with a score.

The heat is on in Vegas where Scott, Brandon and Lori have come to see if they can strike it rich... and not just in the casinos. And guess who’s back? In this boom or bust town, the chance for a big score has also lured Brandon’s nemesis.

A new couple, Scott and Chrissy, force their way onto Brandon and Lori’s turf. A set of wrapped pallets challenges even the most experienced buyers—does the plastic sheeting cover up garbage... or gold?
